description: Record a FALSE-POSITIVE suppression for a finding (never touches source — writes .codeweb/annotations.json): after you verify a deadcode/duplication finding is wrong, suppress its fingerprint so it stops resurfacing; the finding count reports suppressed separately. list:true shows current suppressions.

graph.description: Path to graph.json. OPTIONAL — defaults to CODEWEB_WS or the nearest .codeweb/graph.json above cwd

list.description: List current suppressions instead of adding one

note.description: Why this finding is a false positive (stored with the suppression)

suppress.description: The finding fingerprint to suppress (from deadcode/overlap output)

name: codeweb_annotate
